triggers.description: Bare Actuating reconciles implementation, publication, review, and closure.
Explicit bounded routes select implement, triage, remediation-plan, or review-closeout.
A current bug or falsifier may expose a semantic hotspot or architecture defect.
exclusions: isolated syntax or mechanical mistake wholly inside an already-correct owner
environment failure with no semantic boundary implication

triggers.description: Current evidence falsifies or extends the incumbent architecture.
exclusions: diff size or implementation rewrite alone
one local defect whose complete family is already excluded by the incumbent

triggers.description: Unqualified review, inspect, audit, or classify intent is non-mutating triage.

routes.description: Reconcile and realize the current target locally.
Acquire and classify current owner evidence without mutation.
Resolve current review pressure, publish when required, and converge.
Hand exact Git and validation facts to Ship.

required_artifacts: owner-issued validation, review, and publication evidence when applicable
success_signals: Git is the realized construction
CAS owns review attempts
Ship owns public effects
Actuating keeps no durable workflow store
failure_signals: Actuating copies owner facts into an event log
a stored Actuating verdict outranks current owner state
Ledger grants mutation, review credit, or closure
clauses.rationale: Reconciliation remains current when durable facts stay with their owners and interpretations are recomputed.

required_artifacts: detection surface distinct from candidate admission frontier
current Review Fold family evidence when multiple witnesses are claimed
bounded repository-native semantic scar tissue when applicable
counterexample topology and correctness delta when architecture reopens
success_signals: a bug is treated as a counterexample rather than a patch instruction
one universal-law falsifier may reopen architecture immediately
semantic hotspots require same-law owner evidence rather than file proximity
the incumbent is preserved only when its existing owner excludes the complete evidenced family
the selected target states invalid region eliminated, escape paths retired, and residual invalidity
failure_signals: detection surface is treated as admission frontier without evidence
bug or finding maps directly to a patch
file proximity, churn, or an arbitrary bug count establishes a hotspot
another guard is called correct by construction while the same invalid family remains admitted
a hotspot registry, score, threshold, receipt, or durable store is created
clauses.rationale: Bugs improve architecture only when their counterexample families are traced to the earliest owned admission seam and excluded there.

required_artifacts: incumbent model reconstructed from the current tree
Architecture Working Set when selection reopens
success_signals: local repair preserves an incumbent already closed under the complete obligation or counterexample family
semantic novelty, universal-law falsification, or semantic hotspot reopens selection before mutation
the smallest correctness-non-dominated candidate is selected
First Principles, Universalist, bounded Metanoetic challenge, and Reduce retain their authority boundaries
failure_signals: new semantics hide inside a realization repair
candidate comparison ignores invalid states, escape paths, owner dilution, or residual proof burden
incomparable minima are collapsed into a scalar score
prior analysis substitutes for current repository evidence
clauses.rationale: Architecture selection minimizes current admitted incorrectness while preserving every required valid observation and compatibility obligation.

required_artifacts: exact CAS receipts for the current Git head
success_signals: initial standard plus four compact auxiliaries launch concurrently
five consecutive standard cleans bind the exact unchanged head
material head change invalidates credit by identity
missing resumable evidence restarts a fresh wave
failure_signals: full standalone auxiliary workflows recursively launch inside the wave
review evidence copied into an Actuating store
clauses.rationale: CAS-owned receipts provide durable attempt facts; Actuating derives credit without duplicating them.

required_artifacts: witness rejection and family-elimination proof when bug-driven
success_signals: closure is reevaluated from live owner facts
accepted witnesses are rejected through sanctioned paths
selected counterexample families are excluded at the canonical owner or residual invalidity is explicit and owned
publication-before-review adoption is bound through the Ship observation digest in CAS request fingerprints
no closure receipt or Evidence event is required
failure_signals: Ship requires an Actuating closure receipt
rejection of one example substitutes for family elimination
publication, process exit, or a summary count substitutes for current proof
clauses.rationale: Completion is a head-relative correctness predicate, not durable control state.

instrumentation.rationale: The current Git tree and owner-issued evidence are the facts; Actuating reports its live judgment without persisting a peer authority artifact or hotspot registry.
